g.text: G1: locked policy performance and cost
* Selection-locked arm; holdout never reselects. Hatching: default budget fails in at least one source.
AUC integrates nominal budgets, not realized cost. Holdout AUC is N/A: xroutebench high quality is below low.
Dashed 0.5 line shows the macro reference; feasibility is checked per source.
